author: 1337isnot1337, with OpenAI Codex assistance
statement: Three author-checked scoped lemmas: squarefree formal modes retain exp(Omega(M/sqrt(u))) choices under strengthened uniform weights and degree caps; the level-dependent Hermite-product loss has exact real optimum W/(w^T B^-1 1)=Theta(W/u); local Cauchy Smith valuations are 4j-2 popcount(j). No new SAT bound or lower bound for all contractions.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the written scoped proofs; finite checks do not establish the all-size lemmas
Formal mode choices need not have nonzero coefficients on SAT inputs; exploit support, cancellation or aggregation to escape the model
The product-loss optimum is not a lower bound for every recovery algorithm; a changed recovery functional remains open
A different kernel or representation needs integrality, locality, precision, entry and recursive cost proofs
A complete uniform all-input 3-SAT improvement remains open; alpha stays 1/2
